label: The 6T cell and the array
subgoals: Count six transistors per stored bit
Multiply words by bits for the cell count
Select one row by raising its wordline from the row decoder

label: Column multiplexing
subgoals: Divide the word count by the column-mux factor for the rows
Multiply the word width by the mux factor for the columns
Split the address into row bits and column bits

label: Choosing the shape
subgoals: Set rows equal to columns to find the square mux factor
Compute the mux factor as the square root of words over bits
Split very large arrays into banks
